briefdescription.para: Compare left boundaries of two intervals.

detaileddescription.para: Let 'A' and 'B' be the intervals of keys from the left boundary of 'a' and 'b' to plus infinity, respectively. Assume that

listitem.para: a > b iff A is spanned by B
a = b iff A equals B
a < b iff A spans B

briefdescription.para: Compare right boundaries of two intervals.

detaileddescription.para: Let 'A' and 'B' be the intervals of keys from minus infinity to the right boundary of 'a' and 'b', respectively. Assume that

listitem.para: a > b iff A spans B
a = b iff A equals B
a < b iff A is spanned by B

briefdescription.para: Return true if two intervals should be merged.

detaileddescription.para: Interval 'l' must start before interval 'r'. Note, if this function returns true, it does not necessarily mean that the intervals intersect - they might complement each other, e.g.

briefdescription.para: Return the next conflicting transaction or NULL.

detaileddescription.para: Note, the same transaction may be returned more than once.
